positions.title: Library Assistant
positions.description: Responsible  for  performing  routine  clerical  duties  within  the  library  and  assisting  library  staff. Provide general  and  specific  information on  policies and procedures  for the  library. Perform  inter-library loan process. Using automated library systems to conduct research and assist the customer on obtaining usable information. "  Assist students with locating information through multiple databases "  Maintain records of overdue materials and generate recovery documentation "  Provide assistance with multimedia use configuring the systems for student based on demand "  Patrol library and ensure rules are being followed and students are assisted
